description: Ministry of Power and Energy - Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961 order under Section 66 - Revise the Fuel Price
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory order issued under Section 66 of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961, revising fuel prices. While it mentions the Minister of Energy by name, the primary content is regulatory action (price revision) authorized by existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
